description.en: All four factions: Zhang Fei, Cao Cao, Sun Quan, Guan Yu and Jia Xu. Straightforward combat and spell play.
description.zh_CN: 四方势力齐聚：张飞、曹操、孙权、关羽、贾诩，以直接的交战与计策取胜。

description.en: Zhou Yu and Gan Ning strengthen your board. Silk-Sail Raiders grow after combat; Tower Ships break towers.
description.zh_CN: 周瑜与甘宁强化全军。锦帆贼每战愈强，楼船攻破城楼。

description.en: Sima Yi and Lü Bu threaten heroes. Use cross-lane damage, removal and board clears to control combat.
description.zh_CN: 司马懿与吕布专克武将。以跨路伤害、处斩与清场掌控战局。

description.en: Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang and Sun Shangxiang stand with Lu Su and Huang Gai: forts and stratagems hold the line while fire ships and seasoned troops break it.
description.zh_CN: 刘备、诸葛亮、孙尚香联手鲁肃、黄盖：以城防与计谋固守，以火船与百战之兵破敌。

description.en: Zhao Yun, Wei Yan and Jiang Wei march north, shredding armour and striking back, while Cao Cao's and Sima Yi's schemes direct the fighting.
description.zh_CN: 赵云、魏延、姜维挥师北上，破甲反击；曹操与司马懿的谋略调度战局。

description.en: Ma Chao duels, Huang Zhong and Pang Tong hold the line, Huang Yueying's wooden beasts sap the enemy and Lü Bu cuts down their generals.
description.zh_CN: 马超单挑，黄忠与庞统坐镇，黄月英的木兽削弱敌军，吕布斩将夺旗。

description.en: Lu Xun, Da Qiao and Taishi Ci fortify the river and shift troops between lanes; Cao Cao's and Sima Yi's stratagems strike from afar.
description.zh_CN: 陆逊、大乔、太史慈筑坞固守、调兵遣将；曹操与司马懿的谋略远程制敌。

description.en: Sun Ce sweeps Jiangdong with Zhou Tai on guard and Xiao Qiao's care, while Jia Xu and Lü Bu cut down rival heroes.
description.zh_CN: 孙策横扫江东，周泰护驾、小乔照拂；贾诩与吕布斩除敌将。

description.en: At Cao Cao's court in Ye, Guo Jia and Sima Yi turn every stratagem twice, Xiahou Dun keeps the orders flowing and Zhen Ji's ode gathers its strength.
description.zh_CN: 邺城曹营之中，郭嘉与司马懿计策连环，夏侯惇号令不绝，甄姬的《洛神赋》蓄势待发。

description.en: Lü Bu and Chen Gong hold Xiapi with Zhang Liao's raids, while Jia Xu's poisoned counsel and Xu Chu's Tiger Guards close the ring.
description.zh_CN: 吕布与陈宫据守下邳，张辽往来突袭；贾诩毒计、许褚虎卫步步合围。

description.en: Deng Ai's farm soldiers and Xiahou Yuan's swift columns crowd the frontier against Jiang Wei and Wei Yan, while Dian Wei hurls halberds at the front.
description.zh_CN: 邓艾的屯田兵与夏侯渊的神速之师布满边陲，对阵姜维与魏延；典韦阵前掷戟。

description.en: At Fengyi Pavilion Diaochan turns Lü Bu against Dong Zhuo; Gao Shun's raids and Jia Xu's schemes make every lane an ambush.
description.zh_CN: 凤仪亭中，貂蝉离间吕布与董卓；高顺奔袭、贾诩设谋，三路处处伏兵。

description.en: Yuan Shao's coalition storms the passes: Sun Jian is first up the ladders, Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei charge, and stone throwers batter the walls.
description.zh_CN: 袁绍盟军强攻关隘：孙坚先登，刘备、关羽、张飞冲阵，投石兵猛轰城楼。

description.en: Zhang Jiao calls down Heaven's thunder as Yellow Heaven Rises; Zuo Ci's arts, Lady Zhurong's flying knives and Hua Tuo's powder strike the generals, and Sima Yi's lightning finishes them.
description.zh_CN: 张角呼风唤雷，黄天当立；左慈的遁甲、祝融的飞刀与华佗的麻沸散专攻敌将，司马懿再以天雷收尾。

description.en: Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Ma Chao and Huang Zhong ride out with the Serpent Spear and the Zhuge Crossbow; the Bright Light Armor and the Ferghana Horse grow stronger with every battle.
description.zh_CN: 关羽、张飞、赵云、马超、黄忠五虎齐出，执丈八蛇矛、诸葛连弩；明光铠与大宛马每战愈强。

description.en: Sun Quan dons the Dragon Robe at Wuchang; Zhou Yu, Lu Xun, Gan Ning and Zhou Tai guard Jiangdong behind the Black Tortoise Shield and the Benevolent King Shield.
description.zh_CN: 孙权于武昌身披龙袍称帝；周瑜、陆逊、甘宁、周泰持玄武盾、仁王盾拱卫江东。

description.en: At Guandu Cao Cao rides Jueying with the Yitian Sword; Xu Chu and Zhang Liao raid Wuchao, Guo Jia counsels, Xiahou Dun holds the camp and Cao Ren's Eight-Gate Lock scatters the attackers.
description.zh_CN: 官渡之战，曹操乘绝影、佩倚天剑；许褚、张辽奇袭乌巢，郭嘉献策，夏侯惇坚守大营，曹仁八门金锁阵打散来敌。

description.en: Lü Bu rides Red Hare with the Sky Piercer and the Purple-Gold Crown; Jia Xu schemes, Yuan Shao pays for every head, Hua Tuo heals and Zuo Ci conjures: each warlord takes what he can.
description.zh_CN: 吕布跨赤兔、执方天画戟、戴紫金冠；贾诩设谋、袁绍重金购首、华佗施术、左慈弄法，群雄各取所需。

description.en: Guo Jia foresees the fall of the Yuans and Jia Xu counsels patience: while Yuan Shao's sons feud, rams, siege towers and tunnels close in on Ye, Xu Chu's Tiger Guards hold the camp and Zhen Ji waits behind the walls.
description.zh_CN: 郭嘉料定袁氏必亡，贾诩劝以缓图：袁绍诸子同室操戈之际，冲车、井阑与地道合围邺城，许褚的虎卫坚守大营，甄姬困守城中。

description.en: Guan Yu holds Jing behind river beacons and Lady Sun's Fort while Lu Su bargains for it; Lü Meng crosses the river in white and Lu Xun waits out the weary to take the land of fish and rice.
description.zh_CN: 关羽凭江防烽燧与孙夫人城镇守荆州，鲁肃单刀赴会索要此地；吕蒙白衣渡江，陆逊以逸待劳，终取这片鱼米之乡。

description.en: Dong Zhuo hoards the court's gold in Mei Fortress with Lü Bu at his side; Cao Cao flees the capital to swear the blood oath against him, Diaochan's charm turns father against son, and Jia Xu counsels Dong Zhuo's generals to strike back.
description.zh_CN: 董卓敛尽天下财货于郿坞，吕布随侍左右；曹操逃离京城，歃血会盟共讨国贼；貂蝉一计令义父子反目，贾诩又劝董卓旧部反攻长安。

description.en: Zhang Liao's eight hundred storm Sun Quan's camp past horse pitfalls and crossbow batteries; Gan Ning and Zhou Tai cut a way out, heaven protects Sun Quan's leap over the broken bridge, and Xiahou Dun brings up the reinforcements.
description.zh_CN: 张辽率八百勇士冲破陷马坑与强弩营直扑孙权大营；甘宁、周泰杀出重围，孙权跃马飞渡断桥，吉人天相，夏侯惇援军随后杀到。

description.en: Four colors, familiar basic heroes, straightforward combat and spell play.
Drow and Lycan strengthen your board. Savage Wolves grow after combat; Thunderhide Pack breaks towers.
Zeus and Phantom Assassin threaten heroes. Use cross-lane damage, removal and board clears to control combat.
Sven and Pugna lead Mazzie's improvements, Viper's poison and Chen's converts; creeps that grow after combat back them up.
description.zh_CN: 斯温与帕格纳领衔，梅兹的强化、冥界亚龙的剧毒与陈的感化相辅；战后成长的小兵稳步推进。

description.en: Timbersaw, Ursa and Centaur Warrunner strip armor and punish attackers; Zeus and J'Muy add burn, card draw and redirection.
description.zh_CN: 伐木机、熊战士与半人马战行者削甲反击；宙斯与睿智的姆伊提供灼烧、抽牌与调度。

description.en: Legion Commander duels, Bristleback and Tidehunter hold the lane, Beastmaster's beasts weaken blockers and Phantom Assassin finishes heroes.
description.zh_CN: 军团指挥官决斗，钢背兽与潮汐猎人坐镇，兽王的野兽削弱阻挡者，幻影刺客收割英雄。

description.en: Treant Protector, Enchantress and Dark Seer armor, heal and reposition the board; Zeus and J'Muy control it with spells.
description.zh_CN: 树精卫士、魅惑魔女与黑暗贤者为战线加护、治疗并调整站位；宙斯与睿智的姆伊以法术掌控局面。

description.en: Magnus, Abaddon and Omniknight empower, shield and heal; Debbi and Phantom Assassin remove the heroes in their way.
description.zh_CN: 马格纳斯、亚巴顿与全能骑士强化、护盾并治疗；狡诈的黛比与幻影刺客除掉挡路的英雄。

description.en: Luna charges Eclipses while Crystal Maiden and Ogre Magi refill mana and copy spells; J'Muy and Zeus add card draw and burn.
description.zh_CN: 露娜为月蚀充能，冰晶圣女与食人魔魔法师回复魔力、复制法术；睿智的姆伊与宙斯提供抽牌与灼烧。

description.en: Earthshaker and Outworld Devourer stun and imprison while Prellex's Barracks flood the lanes; Phantom Assassin and Debbi pick off heroes.
description.zh_CN: 撼地者与殁境神蚀者晕眩、禁锢敌军，普瑞蕾斯的兵营源源出兵；幻影刺客与狡诈的黛比收割英雄。

description.en: Venomancer's Plague Wards, Meepo's clones and Call the Reserves crowd the lanes; Skywrath Mage, Centaur Warrunner and Ursa finish what is left.
description.zh_CN: 剧毒术士的瘟疫守卫、米波的分身与呼叫预备军挤满兵线；天怒法师、半人马战行者与熊战士收拾残局。

description.en: Winter Wyvern, Bloodseeker and Storm Spirit move, curse and pick their battles; Phantom Assassin and Debbi finish the heroes they catch.
description.zh_CN: 寒冬飞龙、血魔与风暴之灵随意移动、诅咒并挑选战斗对象；幻影刺客与狡诈的黛比解决落单的英雄。

description.en: Sorla Khan and Bounty Hunter bring Assault Ladders, catapults and gold-hungry creeps against the towers; Sven, Keefe and Axe fight in front.
description.zh_CN: 索尔拉可汗与赏金猎人带着攻城梯、投石器与贪财的小兵进攻防御塔；斯温、勇者基弗与斧王冲在前方。

description.en: Tinker, Lion and Sniper shoot down units with their abilities while March of the Machines and Necrophos wear the lane down; Zeus strikes every enemy hero.
description.zh_CN: 修补匠、莱恩与狙击手以技能精准击杀单位，机械行军与瘟疫法师消耗兵线；宙斯打击所有敌方英雄。

description.en: Keefe, Axe, Timbersaw, Legion Commander and Bristleback duel and battle up front, armed with Stonehall gear that grows after every combat and Wingfall Hammer's regeneration.
description.zh_CN: 勇者基弗、斧王、伐木机、军团指挥官与钢背兽冲锋在前、单挑混战；石堂城装备每战愈强，折翼之锤提供恢复。

description.en: Farvhan, Drow Ranger, Treant Protector, Lycan and Abaddon hold the line behind shields and Vesture of the Tyrant, while Book of the Dead raises the fallen creeps.
description.zh_CN: 梦者法瓦汗、卓尔游侠、树精卫士、狼人与亚巴顿以护盾与暴君王袍固守战线，亡者之书唤起阵亡的小兵。

description.en: J'Muy, Earthshaker, Prellex, Ogre Magi and Crystal Maiden blink, swap and steal creeps with Blink Dagger, Phase Boots and Helm of the Dominator, while Claszureme Hourglass locks the opponent's draws.
description.zh_CN: 睿智的姆伊、撼地者、普瑞蕾斯、食人魔魔法师与冰晶圣女借闪烁匕首、相位鞋与支配头盔闪现、换位并控制小兵；超维视界沙漏锁住对手抽到的牌。

description.en: Debbi, Phantom Assassin, Bounty Hunter, Necrophos and Lion hunt heroes for gold with Poaching Knife, Revtel Signet Ring and Apotheosis Blade, then spend it in the shop.
description.zh_CN: 狡诈的黛比、幻影刺客、赏金猎人、瘟疫法师与莱恩以盗猎刀、瑞文泰尔印戒与封神之刃猎杀英雄换取金钱，再到商店中花掉。

description.en: Ogre Magi and Debbi wear the towers down with Ignite, Trebuchets, Unsupervised Artillery and a Steam Cannon while Bitter Enemies counts down; Bounty Hunter, Luna and Prellex's Barracks hold the lanes.
description.zh_CN: 食人魔魔法师与狡诈的黛比以引燃、投石机、无人看管的火炮与蒸汽大炮消磨防御塔，夙敌的倒计时步步逼近；赏金猎人、露娜与普瑞蕾斯的兵营坚守兵线。

description.en: Keefe, Mazzie and Rix fight behind Burning Oil and Steel Reinforcement under Grand Melee; Treant Protector and Chen heal while Unearthed Secrets, Path of the Dreamer and Homefield Advantage hold the towers.
description.zh_CN: 勇者基弗、梅兹与里克斯在大乱斗中依托滚烫火油与铜墙铁壁作战；树精卫士与陈负责治疗，秘密出土、梦者之路与地主优势守住防御塔。

description.en: Bloodseeker, Phantom Assassin and Winter Wyvern fight under The Oath and Assured Destruction while The Tyler Estate starves both towers; J'Muy redirects, Debbi finishes off heroes, and Iron Fog Goldmine and Revtel Investments fill the purse.
description.zh_CN: 血魔、幻影刺客与寒冬飞龙在誓约与同归于尽之下作战，泰勒庄园令双方的塔缺少魔力；睿智的姆伊调度战场，狡诈的黛比收割英雄，铁雾金矿与瑞文泰尔的资产充实钱袋。

description.en: Earthshaker and Crystal Maiden stun and freeze what Glyph of Confusion and Conflagration let through; Farvhan, Lycan and Abaddon shield and grow the board with Mist of Avernus, Cheating Death and Selemene's Favor.
description.zh_CN: 撼地者与冰晶圣女震晕、冰冻困惑符文与烈焰放过的敌人；梦者法瓦汗、狼人与亚巴顿借魔霭迷雾、命不该绝与赛莉蒙妮的眷顾护盾并壮大战线。
